text:
jordan_rev: Heads up — MonarchBank wants to progress the POC but their procurement blocked on compliance artifacts (SOC2 docs), a signed pen-test letter, and cost for a customer-isolated staging VPC. Can we list what we can share immediately and an ETA?
nina_security: Quick question: do they need SOC 2 scope to include staging? If yes, we need to note differences between prod controls and staging hardening. Typical ask: Type II (redacted), control matrix, network diagram, user access review sample, and pen-test attestation.
devin_eng: For a customer-isolated staging VPC we need to decide between a short-lived Dedicated pool vs Private deploy. Dedicated reserved nodes have procurement lead time. Shared staging is fastest but doesn't meet strict isolation. Approx cost: shared dev env ~ $1/hr, isolated small pool ~ $14/hr reserved.
sara_ps: I'll confirm with the customer whether staging needs full tenant isolation or just IP allowlist. Also ask if they'll accept presigned S3 links or require a secure dataroom (Box/SharePoint).
jordan_rev: They said dataroom preferred, presigned ok for speed. They specifically called out encryption-at-rest proof and KMS separation as procurement blockers.
nina_security: We'll prepare a short KMS/HSM FAQ (high level) and a redaction note explaining we remove user identifiers from SOC2 reports. Also: do we allow customer-led pen tests against staging? If yes, we need a signed engagement letter + scheduled window.
devin_eng: We can allow external scans with whitelisted IPs and a maintenance window. Need SSO test accounts if they want authenticated tests; these are short-lived service accounts we can create. Note: if they run heavy load it could trigger autoscaling & cost.
sara_ps: Proposed artifact checklist to send now:
``
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF)
- Control mapping (app + infra)
- Sample user access review
- Network diagram (staging & prod differences noted)
- Pen-test engagement letter (draft)
- KMS/HSM summary + key rotation policy excerpt
- Data residency confirmation (region list)
```
I can attach redaction guidance and the minimal legal notice.
ops_bot: Security note: for presigned S3 uploads we recommend 7-day expiry and MFA for dataroom access. For external scans, schedule during business hours and limit scan IP ranges.
nina_security: I'll draft the pen-test engagement letter with an attestation clause and an external-scan coordination section. Legal usually signs; they'll need 1-2 business days for review.
jordan_rev: Timeline suggestion: redacted docs and checklist within 24 hours, pen-test letter draft within 2 business days, legal sign-off 1-3 business days after that, staging ready (isolated) in 5-7 business days after infra sign-off. Does that sound doable?
devin_eng: Yes with caveats: isolated staging requires networking approvals (peering/VPN) and possibly a short procurement for reserved nodes if they want dedicated capacity. That adds lead time if PO > $X.
sara_ps: I'll ask the customer for their preferred pen-test dates, whether they want to provide their own vendor, and the dataroom contact. Also request expected concurrency (qps) for the workload so engineering can size the pool.
jordan_rev: Great. I'll draft an email summarizing the phased plan and the cost ranges. If anyone has edits to the checklist, update within the hour.
ops_bot: Upload policy reminder: watermark shared PDFs and restrict download where possible.
nina_security: No objections. I'll post the pen-test draft here for quick feedback before involving legal.
devin_eng: I'll prepare a short pricing table (shared vs isolated vs reserved) and post it in the thread.
sara_ps: Pinged customer — awaiting response. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
